Subject: Feedback on Workplace Conduct

Dear [Employee Name],

I am writing to share some feedback regarding recent interactions in the workplace. We have received several reports suggesting that your behavior has not aligned with our company’s core values.

We value a respectful and professional environment for everyone, and we believe that addressing this matter promptly is important for maintaining that standard. We are confident in your ability to make the necessary adjustments and look forward to seeing an immediate improvement in your conduct.

Please let me know if you would like to discuss this further or if there are any resources we can provide to support you in this process.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
